rulesStrings.li: raid(raidProperty==None) ->[PAWN][OTHERS] from [FACTION] raided the colony.
raid(raidProperty==Breacher) ->[PAWN][OTHERS] from [FACTION] raided the colony using breaching tactics.
raid(raidProperty==Sapper) ->[PAWN][OTHERS] from [FACTION] raided the colony using sapper tactics.
raid(raidProperty==Siege) ->[PAWN][OTHERS] from [FACTION] besieged the colony.
raid(raidProperty==CenterDrop)->[PAWN][OTHERS] from [FACTION] raided the colony by dropping directly into it.
raidFriendly(hostileFaction==) ->[PAWN][OTHERS] from [FACTION] came to aid the colony.
raidFriendly(hostileFaction==true)->[PAWN][OTHERS] from [FACTION] came to aid the colony against [HOSTILEFACTION].
bodyPartLost(hasInstigator==true, hasWeapon==true)->[PAWN]'s [PART] was [HEDIFF] by [INSTIGATOR]'s [WEAPON].
bodyPartLost(hasInstigator==true, hasWeapon==) ->[PAWN]'s [PART] was [HEDIFF] by [INSTIGATOR].
bodyPartLost(hasInstigator==,hasWeapon==true) ->[PAWN]'s [PART] was [HEDIFF] by a [WEAPON].
bodyPartLost(hasInstigator==,hasWeapon==) ->[PAWN]'s [PART] was [HEDIFF].
bodyPartLostSurgery(intent==Harvest) ->[PAWN]'s [PART] was harvested by [DOCTOR].
bodyPartLostSurgery(intent==Amputate) ->[PAWN]'s [PART] was amputated by [DOCTOR] due to [HEDIFF].
bodyPartPermanentlyDamaged->[PAWN_label] has a [HEDIFF] in [PAWN_possessive] [PART] by [INSTIGATOR]'s [WEAPON].
tradeCaravanArrived->[PAWN] arrived as part of a [TRADERKIND] caravan from [FACTION].
tradeCaravanLeft(reason==Timeout) ->[PAWN] from [TRADERKIND] of [FACTION] began to leave the colony.
tradeCaravanLeft(reason==DangerousTemperature)->[PAWN] from [TRADERKIND] of [FACTION] began to leave the colony because of dangerous temperature.
tradeCaravanLeft(reason==AnomalousWeather) ->[PAWN] from [TRADERKIND] of [FACTION] began to leave the colony because of anomalous weather.
tradeCaravanLeft(reason==Trapped) ->[PAWN] from [TRADERKIND] of [FACTION] attempted to leave because the caravan became trapped inside.
tradeCaravanLeft(reason==TraderLost) ->[PAWN] from [TRADERKIND] of [FACTION] began to leave the colony after their trader or caravan animal was incapacitated.
tradeCaravanLeft(reason==PawnLost) ->[PAWN] from [TRADERKIND] of [FACTION] began to leave the colony after some of their members were lost.
visitorArrived->[PAWN][OTHERS] from [FACTION] arrived to visit the colony.
travelGroupArrived->[PAWN][OTHERS] from [FACTION] passed by the colony.
